text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin possessed a strong sense of 
responsibility as the eldest daughter. 
While preparing for the races she loved, 
she also worked a part-time job to support 
her younger sisters' dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing that "running is just my own 
selfishness," she works for the sake of 
her family... so that her younger sisters 
can attend dance classes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after making her debut in the Twinkle 
Series, Ines Fujin wanted to keep working 
her part-time jobs. She seemed prepared to 
pour her absolute all into both.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the path ahead is steep and 
rugged, I want to cherish what she 
cherishes just the same. I swore in my 
heart that we would tackle this challenge 
together!"
